offering_description.value: Manufactures roofing membranes, insulation, coatings, spray finishing equipment and industrial components for commercial construction, industrial and transportation customers, sold through contractors, distributors and OEMs.

primary_products.value: roofing membranes; insulation; roof coatings; spray finishing equipment; brake components

customer_segment.value: B2B: roofing contractors, building owners, industrial equipment and vehicle manufacturers

end_markets.value: commercial construction; industrial manufacturing; transportation; agriculture

revenue_model.value: product sales: roofing, insulation and equipment sold to contractors, distributors and manufacturers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes roofing and industrial products from raw materials, sold to contractors and OEMs; brand owner: markets its own brands through distributors and direct accounts

geography_served.value: global: US and Canada make up most sales, also Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: diversified: building envelope products, fluid technologies and transportation or industrial components

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: roofing and building material distributors serving contractors; direct sales: direct sales to OEM and national accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, building code and product safety rules, including brake part safety standards

notes: Portfolio changes, including divestitures of some units, may make parts of this description outdated.
